cohort: 52 healthy, term pregnant women with prior cesarean deliveries
finding: Waist circumference was negatively correlated with changes in hematocrit levels, BMI was positively correlated with skin-to-fascia time, and Pfannenstiel tissue thickness was positively correlated with fascia-to-uterus time during cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study investigated the impact of body fat distribution on bleeding and operation time during cesarean delivery.
